skills.label: what-to-ask
skills.description: Turn rough notes or another agent's result into a prompt.
skills.usage: $what-to-ask Write a prompt for adding CSV export to the filtered table.
skills.example: Use what-to-ask to write a prompt for adding CSV export to the filtered table in Atlas.

skills.label: ask
skills.description: Get an external model opinion through local CLIs.
skills.usage: $ask claude Review my uncommitted changes without editing files.
skills.example: Use ask to get a read-only Claude review of my uncommitted changes.

skills.label: codex-image
skills.description: Delegate image generation to a local Codex CLI.
skills.usage: $codex-image Generate a 1200 × 630 project illustration using Codex.
skills.example: Use codex-image to generate a project illustration using Codex.

skills.label: relay
skills.description: Hand a coding task to Codex or Claude in a worktree and review the diff.
skills.usage: $relay Have Codex add CSV export to the filtered table, then review its diff.
skills.example: Use relay to have Codex add CSV export to the filtered table and review its diff.

skills.label: your-turn-handoff
skills.description: Add a clear result and next step to agent replies.
skills.usage: $your-turn-handoff Use the handoff format for replies in this chat.
skills.example: Use your-turn-handoff for the final answers in this chat.

skills.label: clean-cursor
skills.description: Inspect Cursor storage and plan safe cleanup.
skills.usage: $clean-cursor Inspect Cursor storage without deleting anything.
skills.example: Use clean-cursor to inspect Cursor storage without deleting anything.

skills.label: pii-precommit-check
skills.description: Scan staged Git changes for private data.
skills.usage: $pii-precommit-check Scan my staged changes without committing.
skills.example: Use pii-precommit-check to scan my staged changes without committing.

skills.label: stop-slop
skills.description: Edit or audit prose while preserving voice.
skills.usage: $stop-slop Tighten the draft below while preserving my voice.
skills.example: Use stop-slop to tighten this draft while preserving my voice.

skills.label: github-repo-site
skills.description: Build a GitHub Pages site for any repository.
skills.usage: $github-repo-site Build a GitHub Pages site that explains this repository and how to start.
skills.example: Use github-repo-site to build a GitHub Pages site that explains this repository and how to start.
